📍 Santamaría Bullring, Bogotá, Colombia 🇨🇴 

Built in 1931, this striking Moorish-style arena is one of Bogotá’s best-known historic landmarks. 

Its red-brick façade and horseshoe arches stand out in the city. 

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Bogota #Colombia

📍 Mann Island & Port of Liverpool, England 🇬🇧

Black-clad Mann Island buildings meet the grand 1907 Port of Liverpool Building along the Mersey.

Together, they create one of Liverpool’s most striking waterfront views.

Would you explore it?
#Travel #TravelPhotography #Liverpool #England

📍 Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge 🇭🇰🇨🇳🇲🇴 

Famous for its huge scale: 55 km of bridges, tunnels and artificial islands connect Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macau. 

Opened in 2018, it crosses the Pearl River estuary. 

Would you drive across it?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #China #HongKong
